circuit.name: Boost DC-DC Converter
circuit.description: Step-up DC-DC converter using a single NMOS switch, diode, input inductor, and output capacitor. Boosts 12V input to 30V output at 0.5A load. The inductor stores energy while the switch is on and transfers it to the  output when the switch turns off.

requirements.requirement: Meet target Vout across line (Vin) and load changes
Dynamic response: step changes (line/load) with minimal overshoot and fast settling
Efficiency across load points with loss breakdown
Stress & thermal margins for key devices
